title: FullCalendar
intro: A full-featured calendar component with month, week, day, year, and agenda views. Supports drag-and-drop event management.
tables: PROP
DESCRIPTION
TYPE
DEFAULT
events
Array of calendar events to display
{ id: number; startDate: string; endDate: string; title: string; color: string; description: string; type: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

Callback when a calendar cell is clicked
(date: Date) => void
onEventClick
Callback when an event is clicked
(event: { id: number; startDate: string; endDate: string; title: string; color: string; description: string; type: string; disabled?: boolean }) => void

Callback when events are modified (e.g., drag and drop)

(events: { id: number; startDate: string; endDate: string; title: string; color: string; description: string; type: string; disabled?: boolean }[], event: { id: number; startDate: string; endDate: string; title: string; color: string; description: string; type: string; disabled?: boolean }) => void
